notes: The Andante 24-hour pass costs 7 EUR (metro and bus); metro line E reaches the airport in 30 minutes. Book CP trains to the Douro, Guimarães and Aveiro online (sit on the right for the Douro). The hills are steep.
Winters are rainy at 10-15°C (Porto is wet); September to October brings the golden Douro grape harvest, Christmas lights go up on Aliados, and April to May is ideal.
Francesinha 12-15 EUR, pastel 1.30 EUR, port tasting 20-25 EUR, Lello 10 EUR (counts towards a book), coffee 1 EUR; round up the bill as a tip.
Book Lello online for 09:00; visit Clérigos in the morning; the Douro train fills up on summer weekends, so book ahead; Bolhão market is closed.
Tripas à moda do Porto (tripe, hence the city's nickname "tripeiros"), bacalhau, francesinha, vinho verde, tawny and ruby port.
Ribeira is safe at night; the Gaia cellars close at 17:00.

transit.name: Andante 24-hour pass
transit.why_chosen: Metro, bus and tram; includes metro line E to the airport
transit.coverage: Metro do Porto, STCP otobüs, tramvay

stops.name: São Bento Station
stops.tips: A station hall covered in 20,000 azulejo tiles telling Portuguese history.

stops.name: Ribeira
stops.tips: UNESCO-listed riverside quarter of colourful houses; take in Praça da Ribeira and the narrow lanes.

stops.name: Dom Luís I Bridge
stops.tips: Double-deck iron bridge by a student of Eiffel; walk across the upper level (next to the metro).

stops.name: Taylor's Port Cellars
stops.tips: A port wine cellar in Gaia dating from 1692; audio tour with 3 tastings and a garden terrace.

stops.name: Jardim do Morro Sunset
stops.tips: Garden at the bridge end; watch the Porto skyline at sunset, then take the cable car (6 EUR) down.

backups.name: Graham's Port Lodge
backups.tips: Vintage port and river views; an alternative to Taylor's.

backups.name: Mosteiro da Serra do Pilar
backups.tips: Terrace of a round monastery on the Gaia hilltop; the best view.

stops.name: Livraria Lello
stops.tips: Often called the world's most beautiful bookshop (red staircase); book an online ticket for the 09:00 opening slot (the price counts towards a book).

stops.name: Clérigos Tower
stops.tips: A 76 m Baroque tower with 240 steps; panoramic city views.

stops.name: Igreja do Carmo
stops.tips: Twin churches with a blue-tiled side façade; look for the 1 m-wide house between them.

stops.name: Mercado do Bolhão
stops.tips: Restored 1914 market; cheese, tinned sardines and stalls on the upper floor.

stops.name: Café Majestic
stops.tips: A 1921 Belle Époque café on Santa Catarina; pricey but worth seeing.

backups.name: Casa Guedes Praça Poveiros
backups.tips: Pernil (roast pork leg) sandwich with Serra cheese; expect a queue.

backups.name: Igreja de São Francisco
backups.tips: Baroque interior covered in gold leaf (300 kg of gold); also catacombs.

stops.name: Pinhão Railway Station
stops.tips: The Linha do Douro train from São Bento takes 2.5 hours (along the river, sit on the right-hand side); the station is decorated with tiles.

stops.name: Quinta do Bomfim
stops.tips: Dow's vineyard; terrace tasting and a walk through the vines.

stops.name: Pinhão Rabelo Boat Tour
stops.tips: One hour on a traditional rabelo boat; the terraced vineyards are UNESCO-listed.

stops.name: Pinhão Lunch at Veladouro
stops.tips: Riverside tavern; try posta (veal steak) and Douro wine.

stops.name: Miradouro de Casal de Loivos
stops.tips: The best view of the valley (10 minutes by taxi); the return train leaves at 17:20.

backups.name: Quinta das Carvalhas
backups.tips: Vineyard on the opposite bank; jeep tour.

backups.name: Museu do Douro, Peso da Régua
backups.tips: On the way back, get off at Régua to visit the museum, then catch a later train.

stops.name: Tram 1 Ribeira–Foz
stops.tips: A 1930s wooden tram runs along the river to the Atlantic; board at the Infante stop.

stops.name: Foz do Douro Lighthouse
stops.tips: Lighthouse and crashing waves; see the Pérgola seafront columns.

stops.name: Praia dos Ingleses and Seafront
stops.tips: Winter Atlantic waves; stop for a coffee.

stops.name: Casa de Pasto da Palmeira Foz
stops.tips: Small plates facing the sea; modern Portuguese cooking.

stops.name: Palácio de Cristal Gardens
stops.tips: Terraced gardens with peacocks; views of the river and bridge. Take bus 500.

backups.name: Serralves Museum
backups.tips: Siza's contemporary art museum and Art Deco villa park; an alternative to the Crystal Palace.

backups.name: Brasão Cervejaria Foz
backups.tips: Francesinha (Porto's "heart attack" sandwich) with its sauce.

stops.name: Guimarães Castle
stops.tips: 1 hour by train; a 10th-century castle known as the "birthplace of Portugal".

stops.name: Palace of the Dukes of Braganza
stops.tips: Burgundian-style ducal palace; look out for the tapestries.

stops.name: Largo da Oliveira, Guimarães
stops.tips: UNESCO-listed medieval square; lunch at Cor de Tangerina.

stops.name: Bom Jesus do Monte
stops.tips: Take a bus or train to Braga; a Baroque zigzag staircase of 577 steps and a water-powered funicular (1882), with views.

stops.name: Braga Cathedral
stops.tips: Portugal's oldest cathedral; then the train back.

backups.name: Frigideiras do Cantinho Braga
backups.tips: A café dating from 1796; try the frigideira pastry.

stops.name: Aveiro Moliceiro Boat
stops.tips: 1 hour by train; canal boats in the "Venice of Portugal" (45 minutes) and Art Nouveau houses.

stops.name: Ovos Moles Confeitaria Peixinho
stops.tips: A pastry shop from 1856; ovos moles, an egg yolk sweet (shell-shaped).

stops.name: Costa Nova Striped Houses
stops.tips: 30 minutes by bus; candy-striped fishermen's houses (palheiros) and a beach.

stops.name: Costa Nova Lunch at Dóri
stops.tips: Lagoon-side fish restaurant; try the caldeirada (fish stew).

stops.name: Praia da Costa Nova
stops.tips: Watch the winter waves.

backups.name: Salpoente Aveiro
backups.tips: Bacalhau tasting menu in a former salt warehouse.

stops.name: Rua de Miguel Bombarda Galleries
stops.tips: A street of art galleries; Centro Comercial Bombarda for design.

stops.name: Cedofeita Neighbourhood
stops.tips: Street art (Hazul) and cafés.

stops.name: Manteigaria Porto
stops.tips: Warm pastel de nata; near Clérigos.

stops.name: Rua das Flores
stops.tips: Pedestrian street; say goodbye at Casa Portuguesa do Pastel de Bacalhau.

stops.name: Trindade Metro Airport
stops.tips: Metro line E, 30 minutes; farewell.

backups.name: Bonjardim Grill
backups.tips: Piri piri chicken at a no-frills street restaurant.

backups.name: Casa da Música
backups.tips: Koolhaas's white concrete concert hall; tour at 11:00, an alternative to the galleries.
